## Quick-Cactus (CR 7)

What you thought was a cactus suddenly springs to life and rushes toward you in a blur.  

**XP** 9,600  
N Small plant  
**Init** +10; **Senses** bloodsense 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 21, flat-footed 12 (+10 Dex, +2 natural, +1 dodge)  
**hp** 100 (8d8+36)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +12, **Will** +4  
**Immune** plant traits; **Weaknesses** water-weak  


**Offense**


**Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +17 (1d4+10 plus bleed)  
**Special Attacks** bleed (1d4), needle spray  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 30, **Con** 18, **Int** 3, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 10  
**Base Attack** +6; **CMB** +15, **CMD** 25  
**Feats** Ability Focus (needle spray), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +14, Perception +10, Stealth +25  
**SQ** freeze (as cactus), piercing needles  


**Special Abilities**


**Bloodsense (Ex)** The quick-cactus can detect creatures who have blood as if they have blindsight.  

**Needle Spray (Ex)** The quick-cactus shoots a 30-foot cone of needles. Creatures within the cone must make a DC 20 Reflex save or take 4d4 piercing damage and bleed. The damage of the cone increases 1d4 per 2 HD of the creature, and the DC is Constitution-based.  

**Piercing Needles (Ex)** The quick-cactus deals 1d4 damage plus bleed to any creature who attempts to grapple them. Additionally, any creature that attempts to attack the quick-cactus with a melee natural weapon can make a DC 18 Reflex save. On a failure, you take the damage and bleed.  

**Water-Weak (Ex)** If exposed to water, like rain, create water, or a river, they are slowed as per the spell for 1d4 rounds.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate and hot plains  
**Organization** solitary, trio  
**Treasure** incidental
